Class Link

java.lang.Object
gate.sql.Link
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Link extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Holds the connection to the database and provides a clean interface for transaction management, querying and execution of statements.
Author:
Davi Nunes da Silva

    • getDatabase

      public String getDatabase()
      Returns the JDBC database product name associated with this link.

      The returned value is normalized to uppercase so it can be used safely in database-specific comparisons and switch expressions.

      Returns:
      the uppercase JDBC database product name for the current connection

    • from

      public Query.Compiled.Connected from(String query, CompiledCondition... conditions)
      Prepares a new query for execution.

      Each @ symbol found on the query will be replaced by its respective condition sql string.

      The query returned will be compiled with the parameters of the specified conditions.

      Parameters:
      query - the SQL string to be executed
      conditions - the list of conditions that will replace @ symbols and provide the parameters to be compiled into the query
      Returns:
      a connected and compiled query ready for execution

    • from
